settings.scope: Source thermochemistry and two selected crystalline-product reaction affinities only; no metakaolin phase, global equilibrium claim, kinetic path, nucleation, specimen validation or material admission.

source_interpretations: Kaolinite p382 prints Al2Si2O5(OH)2, inconsistent with its258.160g/mol and the Al2Si2O5(OH)4 formula on pp39,65. Formula selected from pp39,65; printed discrepancy preserved.
BlankA5 for andalusite/mullite interpreted as exact zero in the published polynomial.
Reference entropies taken from each detailed thermal table, not the coarser one-decimal coefficient table.
Andalusite coefficient table extends2000K but detailed table1800K; this review selects only298.15-800K.
USGS1995 quartz alpha transition844K differs from priorNIST847K branch. Only298.15-800K is used here; priorNISTphase unchanged.
High-temperature formation columns use temperature-dependent elemental references; use Hf298 plus Cp integral for caloric coordinates.
source.upstream_measurements: Compilation reviewed; not all upstream calorimetry separately retrieved.

cp_certificate.method: z=sqrt(T), z^4 Cp is an eighth-degree polynomial. Exact rational runtime coefficients expanded in Bernstein form on each rational interval; divide its positive minimum coefficient by right^4. The cover contains the whole selected T domain.
